prior_evidence_policy: Reuse unchanged published raw data and proof assumptions; rerun only affected dependency contracts.

blockers.title: Authorized driver persistence
blockers.acceptance: same-driver exact counters/state parity; cache invalidation on model epoch/method/provider; accepted-state transaction boundary
blockers.scope_note: New screening does not persist authorized implicit sessions.

blockers.title: Selective method choice
blockers.acceptance: same accepted checkpoint and matched progress/error; charge discarded pilots; retain rapid-JVP negative control
blockers.scope_note: Same-checkpoint bounded pilot implemented; rapid-JVP loss reduced, transition and FD losses retained. No future-optimality guarantee.

blockers.title: Derivative-provider benefit
blockers.acceptance: separate permission from measured benefit; no hidden finite differences; callback/fatal accounting
blockers.scope_note: Provider permission remains distinct from benefit; explicit and supplied-JVP losses measured.

blockers.title: Affine forcing
blockers.acceptance: stable phi1 across zero/singular/large scales; independent reference; complete error-cost comparison
blockers.scope_note: Stable constant/harmonic declared actions and affine Lawson wrapper implemented; generic time forcing and slow-carrier losses remain.

blockers.title: Causal accepted trajectories
blockers.acceptance: common observation grid, full residual and embedded acceptance unchanged, all rejected work charged
blockers.scope_note: 210 complete analytic trajectories, 195 within sampled cap; broad-spectrum fallback erases gain and long-time phase remains open.

blockers.title: Parallel causal scheduling
blockers.acceptance: Determinism and full-trajectory timing with scheduling overhead at one and two threads within this resource plan; additional thread scales require a separately budgeted study.
blockers.scope_note: 84 bitwise paired thread observations; no >=1.2x two-thread gain. Prefer single thread for these fixtures.

blockers.title: General annihilator provider
blockers.acceptance: exact relation or full-space witness; repeated roots; near-pole handling; original-space residual
blockers.scope_note: Declared scaled-B relation resolvent implemented and tested, including original residual; automated trustworthy relation discovery and full driver integration remain open.

blockers.title: Spherical physical transport
blockers.acceptance: weighted mass/positivity, spatial/time/remap error separation, physical collision/advection and joint invariants
blockers.scope_note: Conservative weighted diffusion and positivity alternative studied; physical transport, nonlinear collisions and AMR remain open.

blockers.title: Broad production evidence
blockers.acceptance: long-time phase, nonnormal transient, events/restarts/callbacks, common-reference external campaign
blockers.scope_note: Broad production HOLD; no external comparator campaign, no long-time phase or online event closure. Concrete validation plan and conditional error-budget theorem supplied.

blockers.title: 2D/3D extension
blockers.acceptance: actual sparse/matrix-free action and weighted invariant; anisotropy/refinement scaling; discrete and continuum references separated
blockers.scope_note: 2D/3D/sphere time and spatial studies separated; no general nonlinear, anisotropic or remeshing qualification.

search_review.scope: bounded MCTS-inspired scientific tree, not a theorem of globally optimal search
required: Correctness and support violations are hard exclusions
Keep raw failures and incomparable Pareto candidates
Postselection benchmarks remain exploratory until independent replay

findings.detail: few-mode and few-mode-large initially both384; corrected to96 and384. No timing from the duplicate configuration is treated as size-scaling evidence.

Half-splitting a least-subnormal forcing coefficient before phi1 amplification returns zero although dt=1e308 and nu=1e-308 give representable4.16e-16 increment. Preserve Scaled coefficients through complex decomposition; regression requested. Fix inspected: Scaled half-sums plus forcing_scaled preserve coefficients; zero-frequency delegates affine. Regression harmonic_subnormal_forcing_is_not_halved_before_amplification added.
is_probe now covers entry replay and return probe; segments are explicitly disposition order because pilot record precedes earlier-executed explicit batch.
minimum_denominator_ratio=1 cannot pass a strict ratio comparison; constructor now declares/validates(0,1). Degree accessor identified as relation degree.

RODAS guard maps fatal and recoverable toNonFinite; fatal user callback is entered once but native driver can consume additional shortcircuited attempts. These attempts are documented counters, not repeated user calls. Immediate terminal-partial-result semantics remain to implement.
Exact5x5 graph test preserves mass1 but creates−5/512 nearest-neighbor value from nonnegative delta. Retain weightedL2-stable diffusion use and positive uniformization alternative.
Eight-stage lower-triangular map with subdiagonal10 amplifies a first-stage residual by10^7. Include inverse/stability assumption in solution-error theorem.
At1e-5, fullRKL actions12/48/104 versus splitlatitude16/64/64 plus16/64/64 FFTpairs. Heterogeneous work is not a walltime speed comparison; only smoothcosphi modes and fixedgrids validated.
General cost must include minimumstage2 term O(ET/h+ET sqrt(Lambda/h)); shorter square-root-only expression needs hLambda>=1. PDE_SCALABILITY already has full expression.

findings.topic: Periodic projection scope and plot fixture identity
findings.detail: Periodic continuum comparison initializes center-sampled cosine rather than exact cell averages; exclude initial projection error from claim or quantify separately. Sphere operation-count and spatial-error panels use different modes(mu andx), requiring explicit caption.
Q=0 or t=0 with finite state +/-1.5e308 could overflow redundant RKL recurrence. Euler/RKL now bypass after input/step validation; general nonzero-Q extreme-amplitude robustness remains out of scope.
